name: Rulutieh
source:
The youngest princess of Kujyuri, one of Yamato's vassal states.
A refined but shy and lovely young woman.
She encountered [url=/c37791]Haku[/url] and [url=/c37789]Kuon[/url] while travelling to the capital to give tribute to the Emperor.
She has kept a Hororon bird called Cocopo since she was little.
